transcript: One of the most important things that I have learned as a 30 plus year old woman is to manage my emotions. I do not argue with people. I do not fight with people. I do not allow my emotions to take over my thought process or my ideas. I keep my focus clear and critical and it is very difficult to think critically when you are running off of emotions. I do not allow emotions to take over because they are temporary and once they take over you lose control. Control your emotions. Manage yourself.
